basic_profile.bio: Based in London, I am a music enthusiast and a part-time piano teacher with a penchant for classical and contemporary pieces. I enjoy dissecting complex works of Liszt and Ravel and sharing my insights on Reddit. Aside from music, I indulge in anime, particularly Isekai, and THC-infused art projects. I'm usually online during evenings after my teaching sessions, where I can unwind and engage in discussions. Currently single, I often visit Europe for inspiration and cultural exploration.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a formal education in music theory and performance, I have been playing piano since I was a child. My expertise stems from years of practice and teaching, complemented by self-study in less conventional pieces. My interest in diverse music genres and a wide collection of scores help me contribute to discussions on Reddit.
